description: tools/test-projects/input (WEB_PROJECT=input tools/build.sh web): Input.getPointerLockState() with a captured pointer is PENDING until a user gesture, then LOCKED after the gate's synthetic click (CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent). No pixel check: the scene is empty. Then a CDP touch tap switches the input scheme to Touch and a key press back to Keyboard&Mouse (input-device-awareness AC18).
